mapper.select: SELECT s.object_limit_bytes,s.committed_bytes AS used_bytes,s.reserved_bytes, (SELECT coalesce(sum(a.size_bytes),0) FROM pf.asset_object a JOIN pf.file_version v ON v.asset_id=a.id AND v.space_id=a.space_id JOIN pf.file_entry f ON f.id=v.file_id AND f.space_id=v.space_id WHERE a.space_id=s.space_id AND a.status='AVAILABLE' AND f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS retained_bytes, c.category,coalesce(o.bytes,0) AS category_bytes,coalesce(o.objects,0) AS objects FROM pf.space_storage s CROSS JOIN(VALUES('file-version'),('chat-attachment'),('preview'),('text-extraction')) c(category) LEFT JOIN(SELECT category,sum(size_bytes) AS bytes,count(*) AS objects FROM pf.asset_object WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND status='AVAILABLE' GROUP BY category) o ON o.category=c.category WHERE s.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) ORDER BY c.category
SELECT FROM pf.chat_attachment_upload u JOIN pf.chat_attachment a ON a.id=u.attachment_id JOIN pf.asset_object o ON o.id=a.asset_id WHERE u.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF u

SELECT FROM pf.chat_attachment_upload u JOIN pf.chat_attachment a ON a.id=u.attachment_id JOIN pf.asset_object o ON o.id=a.asset_id WHERE u.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND u.actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND u.request_id=#{request}

SELECT a.id,a.space_id,a.actor_id,a.asset_id,a.draft_id,a.conversation_id,a.filename,a.size_bytes,a.sha256,a.status,a.revision,o.object_key FROM pf.chat_attachment a JOIN pf.asset_object o ON o.id=a.asset_id WHERE a.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF a
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.space_storage SET reserved_bytes=reserved_bytes+#{bytes},version=version+1 WHERE space_id=#{space} AND status='ACTIVE' AND object_limit_bytes-reserved_bytes-committed_bytes>=#{bytes}

UPDATE pf.chat_attachment_upload SET status='UPLOADING',transfer_owner=#{owner},transfer_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '120 seconds',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='CREATED' AND expires_at>clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.chat_attachment_upload WHERE id=#{id} AND status='UPLOADING' AND transfer_owner=#{owner} AND transfer_until>clock_timestamp() AND expires_at>clock_timestamp())
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.chat_attachment_upload SET status=#{state},transfer_owner=NULL,transfer_until=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='UPLOADING' AND transfer_owner=#{owner}
UPDATE pf.chat_attachment_upload SET status='VERIFIED',transfer_owner=NULL,transfer_until=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision} AND status IN('UNKNOWN','UPLOADING')

UPDATE pf.space_storage s SET reserved_bytes=s.reserved_bytes-r.bytes,committed_bytes=s.committed_bytes+r.bytes,version=s.version+1 FROM pf.chat_attachment_reservation r WHERE r.upload_id=#{id} AND r.space_id=s.space_id AND r.status='RESERVED' AND s.reserved_bytes>=r.bytes
UPDATE pf.chat_attachment_reservation SET status='COMMITTED',revision=revision+1 WHERE upload_id=#{id} AND status='RESERVED'
UPDATE pf.asset_object SET status='AVAILABLE',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='STAGING'
UPDATE pf.chat_attachment SET status='AVAILABLE',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='STAGING'
UPDATE pf.chat_attachment_upload SET status='COMMITTED',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='VERIFIED'
